verdict.rationale: Missive is a SaaS team-inbox platform that could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence documents a REST API, webhooks, an MCP server and an in-app command bar (⌘/Ctrl+K), but no official command-line tool. Those are developer building blocks or adjacent features and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
